title: Chapter 126: Completing The Transaction
content:
Chapter 126: Completing The Transaction

The eight spider-legged transport vehicles designed by the goblins are really adaptable to the terrain. No matter what the terrain is, they can move briskly.

After a while, hundreds of goblin transport vehicles came from the direction of the Tengu tribe camp.

The huge goblin transport vehicles were loaded with various personnel and goods. Everything was in order, busy but not chaotic.

At this time, the lords of the alliance had also selected the goods and handed the list of purchased goods to Gong Zhe.

Gong Zhe did not slack off the lords of the alliance because of the large orders of the Zerg. He ordered the goblin steward of the caravan who came to prepare the goods on the Zerg purchase list, and he personally quoted the lords of the alliance.

Because the lords of the alliance would also pay with some Zerg energy coins, Gong Zhe also gave discounts to the goods purchased by the lords of the alliance.

He patiently confirmed the purchase matters with the lords of the alliance one by one, arranged the personnel to prepare the goods, and then came to the Zerg host.

"I'm very sorry to have kept you waiting!"

Gong Zhe apologized to the host first.

The Zerg host had no name. Seeing that the Zerg did not mention their own names, Gong Zhe did not ask, but only gave them honorific titles.

"It doesn't matter. Your dedication is worth learning!"

The host conveyed Wu Qing's meaning.

"You are flattering! Dedication is the way of survival for our race!"

Speaking of this, Gong Zhe was also very proud.

It is very remarkable that the goblins can gain the respect of all native races and become a powerful race with a great reputation in such a chaotic world with their inherently weak individual strength.

"Some of the goods purchased by the Zerg are ready and can be traded at any time!"

Gong Zhe personally took the host to the caravan to take a look. A group of human races with good spirits and a large group of people of other races gathered together, waiting to be received by the Zerg.

They were all refugees selected by Wu Qing, with a number of nearly 10,000, accounting for a large proportion of the total number of refugees in the caravan.

Wu Qing sent some Zerg parasites to Mengzhong City in advance. These Zerg parasites have received orders to come and receive personnel and goods.

Gong Zhe was very rigorous in his work. He personally delivered each batch of personnel and goods to the host.

After delivery, the personnel and goods were arranged by the Zerg parasites to the open space on the other side. They were not immediately sent back to Mengzhong City, but were guarded by the accompanying Zerg puppies.

There were nearly 10,000 people delivered. If there was no strong deterrent force, there might be problems. Wu Qing did not need any surprises.

And temporarily arranging the personnel and materials here for temporary storage was a respect for the goblin clan. The goods could not leave the sight of the caravan until the payment was settled.

As the goods purchased by the Zerg were continuously delivered, many of the goblin transport vehicles of the caravan became empty.

When the last item was delivered, the host handed over several bags of Zerg energy coins to Gong Zhe. These Zerg energy coins were large energy coins with 1,000 energy points. The energy stored in these energy coins was not a small amount.

Coupled with the 20-fold premium of Zerg energy coins, this was a huge fortune.

Of course, the exchange was also considerable, that is, nearly 10,000 personnel and various selected goods carried on the backs of hundreds of giant transport lizards.

Gong Zhe held several large bags of Zerg energy coins, and his hands were shaking with excitement. These in his hands were the things that could change his fate.

A team of tall goblin guards came over, took the Zerg energy coins from Gong Zhe's hand, and delivered them to the goblin transport vehicle he was riding.

After the money and goods were settled, the Zerg parasites and puppies transported the purchased personnel and goods back to Mengzhong City.

The goods purchased by the lords of the alliance were also delivered and settled one after another and transported back to Mengzhong City.

At this time, it was late, and the lords of the alliance wanted to rush back to their respective territories, but there was no time, so everyone simply did not go back and prepared to stay in Mengzhong City for one night.

After all the transactions were completed, Gong Zhe gathered with the lords of the alliance again.

"Thank you very much to the Zerg and Alliance lords for your strong support!"

"It's getting late today, and the caravan can only camp in your Alliance's territory!"

"In order to express my gratitude for your support, I have prepared a banquet and invite all the lords to dinner!"

"By the way, there are some things I want to discuss with you lords!"

Gong Zhe invited the Zerg and Alliance lords to the dinner, and also specifically pointed out that there would be things to discuss.

Meng and Hu Wei looked at each other and gladly accepted Gong Zhe's invitation.

The caravan began to camp, and a large number of goblin transport vehicles gathered together in an orderly manner. Even if the camp was completed, it was very simple.

The goblin transport vehicles carrying personnel have places to eat and sleep, and the people in the caravan don't need to get off the car at all.

If you are camping in the wild, as long as you open the Qiyun formation map, everything will be worry-free.

The goblin transport vehicles have strong defensive capabilities and certain offensive capabilities. Together with the goblin guards who guard the caravan, they are enough to deal with most dangers.

…

In a vacant area that Gong Zhe specially ordered people to clear, many novel things were placed, from tables and chairs to kitchen utensils, from tableware to food and drinks, all of which were different from what you usually see.

It can be seen that Gong Zhe has put a lot of thought into it.

“Dear Lords! Please taste the fine wine and food I have collected from all over the place!”

Gong Zhe stood up and invited everyone to taste these rare foods and wines.

Even on the specially made elevated table in front of the host representing Wu Qing, there was a substantial dinner.

Everyone had a rare opportunity to eat these rare foods and drink these rare wines. Under the leadership of the big foodie Meng, everyone began to eat and drink.

The host also slowly ate the food in front of him. Eating something would help him recover his energy.

After eating and drinking, Gong Zhe began to talk about things.

"Dear lords of the alliance, I wonder if this Mengzhong City can be opened to the outside world and rented out? Our Goblin Chamber of Commerce intends to establish a branch here!"

Gong Zhe's words were like a thunder, awakening the alliance lords who were still intoxicated with wine and food.

Wu Qing was also very surprised when he received the urgent message from the host.

"I didn't expect that the Zerg energy coin would be so effective. As soon as it was born, it attracted the world's largest chamber of commerce to move in!"

"If the Goblin Chamber of Commerce can establish a branch in Mengzhong City, the development of Mengzhong City will be just around the corner. This area will be greatly affected and is expected to change its once remote and backward appearance!"

"It will be much more convenient to understand this world through the Goblin Chamber of Commerce!"

Wu Qing absolutely agrees with Gong Zhe's intention.

Meng and the lords of the alliance are of course 100% willing! There are so many benefits for the alliance to have a super power like the Goblin Chamber of Commerce establish a branch in Mengzhong City!

In addition, the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has a very good reputation, and the alliance is backed by the Zerg with the support of the Overlord, so there is nothing to worry about.
